phases.frontendCheck: Separate process wall time for tsrust check and strict TypeScript tsc --noEmit. Includes startup and source reads. Native nominal specialization and TypeScript structural checking have different validation coverage; compare actual frontend costs without claiming equivalent compiler work.
phases.frontendEmit: Separate tsrust emit process wall time including startup and source reads, excluding rustc and execution. Each distinct nominal record specializes identity<T>. Mixed mode alternates explicit and inferred applications; repeated inferred and grouped explicit calls reuse Argument0 at every count.

acceptance: Validate all eight cells with check.py before timing. Preserve generated sources, hashes, generator/toolchain identities, exact commands and individual samples in canonical SQLite at checkpoint 96. These are compile-time scaling workloads, not runtime specialization throughput.
